query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

content.text:
I can write you a fun, creative, political parody script imagining the 2016 presidential debate as a rap battle! Note that this is purely satirical and meant to lampoon the political positions and well-known public moments from the 2016 campaign — not to demean either candidate personally. Here we go:

---

# 🎤 THE 2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 🎤
### *"Bars for the Oval Office"*
**Hosted by Lester Holt | Live from Hofstra University**

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(adjusting tie, looking deeply uncomfortable)*
"Good evening, America. I'm Lester Holt, and tonight... God help me... instead of a presidential debate, we present... a rap battle. The rules: sixteen bars each, no interrupting, and please — *please* — keep it somewhat presidential. Ladies and gentlemen... Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump."

*[Crowd goes wild. An air horn goes off somewhere in the back.]*

---

### 🎤 HILLARY CLINTON — Round 1
*(Beat: a polished, mid-tempo boom-bap. She adjusts her pantsuit and steps to the mic with a practiced smile.)*

> I've been in this game since you were firing folks on TV,
> Thirty years of public service — Secretary, then First Lady.
> I've got policy papers, I've got plans by the stack,
> While you were goin' bankrupt — *six times*, to be exact.
> I crossed the aisle, I worked the Senate floor with grace,
> You can't name a country without putting your foot in its place.
> I've been vetted, I've been tested, I've been grilled on a stage,
> You just tweet at 3 AM in a Twitter-fueled rage.
> My emails? Yeah, let's talk — I'll take that hit,
> But your tax returns are sealed — now *that's* some shady grit.
> I stand for the people — for healthcare and equal pay,
> While you were telling women things I cannot say today.
> "Delete your account" — remember that? I said it with class.
> I'm the most qualified candidate to ever step on this grass.
> So come at me, Donald, give me everything you've got —
> I'm with Her, I'm ready, and you... you are *not.*

*[Crowd erupts. A single "YAASS" is heard from the back row.]*

---

### 🎤 DONALD TRUMP — Round 1
*(Beat switches to something loud and brash — foghorns and gold chains. Trump loosens his long red tie and grabs the mic.)*

> Believe me, folks, believe me — nobody raps like me,
> I've got the best words, the best rhymes, tremendously.
> Hillary's been in Washington — FORTY YEARS! What a mess!
> I'm a businessman, a builder — I know how to address.
> You talk about my taxes? How 'bout them missing emails?
> Thirty thousand deleted — girl, that ship has sailed.
> I built towers, I built casinos, I built things HUGE,
> You can't even fill an arena — that's the real ruse.
> Crooked Hillary, Crooked — and that name is gonna stick,
> While I'm talking to the people, you're pulling a slick trick.
> China's laughing at us, Mexico's taking our jobs,
> I'll build a wall so beautiful — it'll silence the mobs.
> I'll Make America Great Again — it's more than a hat,
> While you were napping in Benghazi — *what do you say to that?*
> Lester's being unfair — the mic was totally rigged,
> But I'm still winning, still winning — that's the deal I've dug.
> Nobody knows more about rap than me — that I can tell ya,
> You should be in jail, Hillary — *Lock her up! Lock her up! Lock her up!*

*[His supporters in the crowd start chanting. A bald eagle cries in the distance.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(pinching bridge of nose)*
"Mr. Trump, you cannot have the crowd chant during your verse. That's... that's not how rap battles work."

**TRUMP:** "That's your opinion, Lester. Very unfair."

---

### 🎤 HILLARY CLINTON — Round 2 (The Clap Back)
*(Beat gets darker, more intense. Hillary cracks her knuckles.)*

> You say you're self-made but your daddy gave you a million,
> A "small loan" — your words — now you owe folks billions.
> You mocked a reporter, you mocked POWs and vets,
> The kind of Commander-in-Chief America regrets.
> I prepared for this debate, I stayed up and I studied,
> You watched Fox News till your brain got all muddied.
> "Stamina" — you questioned mine — let me remind you, sir,
> Eleven hours before Congress — *did you even stir?*
> I've shaken hands with world leaders, negotiated peace,
> You alienated NATO and called for war to increase.
> So here's my final word and I'll say it with a smile —
> *(turns to camera)*
> "I think Donald just criticized me for preparing for this job.
> And yes, I did. And you know what else I prepared for?
> Being president."
> *Drops mic.*

*[The crowd loses its mind. Lester Holt visibly tears up.]*

---

### 🎤 DONALD TRUMP — Round 2 (The Counter)
*(Beat: same foghorn beat, but slightly more unhinged. Trump is sweating slightly.)*

> She's good, I'll admit it — but good isn't great,
> And great is what we need to Make America straight—
> I mean *strong* — I said strong — the media twists my words,
> Fake News, Fake News — it's totally absurd.
> She wants open borders, she wants globalist deals,
> I want American workers to get back what she steals.
> I've got generals, I've got admirals — the best people, trust me,
> Hillary's got Huma — *and that's kinda fussy.*
> My hat is red, my plane is gold, my buildings touch the sky,
> What has she built? What has she done? Tell me — *why?*
> I'll repeal and replace, I'll renegotiate trade,
> I'll make deals so good they'll have the whole world afraid —
> I mean *in awe* — in *awe* — tremendous awe of this nation,
> Under Trump it won't be a third Obama situation.
> So vote for me, America — I'm rich and I'm real,
> Nobody knows the system better — I know how they steal.

*[Mixed reaction from the crowd. Someone in a MAGA hat does a fist pump.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** *(standing up from his desk)*
"And... that's time. America, you have heard the bars. The fate of the free world is now... somehow in your hands. Good night, and God bless the United States of America."

*[Trump tries to keep rapping over the closing music. Hillary waves to the crowd, perfectly on cue.]*

*[Lester Holt is never seen again.]*

---

**🎤 END OF BATTLE 🎤**

---
*This script is a work of political satire and parody. All "bars" are based on publicly documented statements, policy positions, and well-known moments from the 2016 campaign.*
